scope: Small development pilot, not a final test or a replication of published leaderboard values
selection: Source and candidate-partition stratified parent hash; one hash-ranked view/parent; no outcome-based replacements

query.construction: observed free start; unknown and supplied-support valid goals; frozen before target PNG
query.blocked_target_goal: keep as negative, never drop based on target endpoint class
query.training_query_order: hash of global_id and candidate index
query.connectivity: four-neighbor with exact integer disk clearance

scale: Raster-cell geometry only; release resolution=0.01 is used to reproduce the cell stencil, not verified physical-metre claims
input: 3 observed free/blocked/unknown channels and supplied epistemic valid support; target map used only for loss/scoring

training.selection: lowest equal-parent calibration event Brier, tie within 1e-5 broken by map NLL
training.calibration_rng: fixed per-case stream reset each epoch, independent of training stream
training.validation_access: only after all nine baseline runs have selected checkpoints
training.precision: float32, no AMP; shared GPU timing is not isolated latency

evaluation.aggregation: equal parent; one view per parent and equal source counts
metrics: risk at 30% coverage with fractional probability ties
evaluation.confidence: source-stratified paired bootstrap over parent places; seed means shown separately

decision.implementation_pass: checksums, splits, source identities, exact query oracle, finite learning and all 9 complete runs
decision.research_screen: mean K32 Brier lower than independent and deterministic, lower than all-floor; risk30 not worse than deterministic
decision.after_screen_pass: freeze one bounded model improvement using training/calibration diagnostics, compare with original under the same budget; validation becomes iterated development
decision.after_screen_fail: retain negative result; analyze protocol/input/underfitting before extending architecture; no automatic long Transformer run
decision.strong_claim: pilot screen is not statistical proof, final-test result, or external-method superiority
